I replied to Pree in your DM to confirm that Elodie Halvorsen is now her go-to person at Marrow Agrisupply for escalations on the Bittern rollout.

The brain saves every DM automatically, and only Pree can see it. I didn't use gbrain's `remember` tool to save a separate note, because its settings don't make clear who could see that note. A shared note could expose her DM to others.
